otherFindings.summary: Because 'Astana' is remapped to Asia/Almaty, reminder display and entered times shift by an hour for readers in that zone.
Changes to plain_text_conversion alter Markdown export text and note excerpts: list numbering changes, and script/style content is dropped.
Trix moved to the action_text-trix gem, so the Trix 2.1.15 CSS no longer matches the vendored Trix 1.3.5 JavaScript, and someone has to decide which Trix to keep.
The built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated in 8.1 and removed in 8.2, which means moving to Sidekiq 7.3.3+ and off redis-rb 4.
